Section top_margin setter incorrectly halves the value

#### Description

When setting the `top_margin` property on a Section object, the value is being halved unexpectedly. This causes the actual margin to be half of what was intended.

#### Steps/Code to Reproduce

```python
from docx import Document
from docx.shared import Inches

# Create a document and get the first section
doc = Document()
section = doc.sections[0]

# Set top margin to 1 inch
section.top_margin = Inches(1)

# The actual margin is now 0.5 inches instead of 1 inch
print(f"Expected: {Inches(1)}")
print(f"Actual: {section.top_margin}")
```

The expected output should show both values as the same, but the actual top_margin will be half the value that was set.
</issue>
